answer.summary: Two ArchUnit architecture tests fail deterministically, and both point at code this PR changed. FindingRepository.detachFromInjects/detachFromScenarios are now called from InjectService and ScenarioService, which breaks the tenant table-access rule. Several @Transactional delete methods now self-invoke their new overloads, which bypasses the Spring proxy. Re-running will fail the same way. The Jackson parse error near line 1246 is unrelated noise.
